name: Apigenin
aliases: chamomile, 4,5, 7-Trihydroxyflavone, 4',5,7-Trihydroxy-Flavone, Apigenol, C.I. Natural Yellow 1, spigenin, versulin
summary: Apigenin (4′,5,7-trihydroxyflavone), found in many plants, is a flavone compound that is the aglycone of several naturally occurring glycosides. It is a yellow crystalline solid that has been used to dye wool.
